description_en: Queries the detailed information about an authorization rule
description_zh: 获取指定授权规则详情
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-rule --instance-id bastionhost-cn-wwo35essw07 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --rule-id 18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetRule

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the authorization rule to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758868.html operation to query the authorization rule ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的授权规则ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758868.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: rule_id

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Rule.description_en: The returned information about the authorization rule

Comment.description_en: The remarks of the authorization rule

Databases.description_en: The databases on which permissions are granted by using the authorization rule

DatabaseAccounts.description_en: The database accounts on which permissions are granted by using the authorization rule
DatabaseAccounts.description_zh: 已授权数据库账户信息

DatabaseAccountId.description_en: The ID of the database account that the policy authorizes users to manage

DatabaseId.description_en: The ID of the database that the policy authorizes users to manage

EffectiveEndTime.description_en: The end time of the validity period of the authorization rule. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
EffectiveEndTime.description_zh: 授权规则有效期结束时间（秒，时间戳格式）

EffectiveStartTime.description_en: The start time of the validity period of the authorization rule. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
EffectiveStartTime.description_zh: 授权规则有效期开始时间（秒，时间戳格式）

HostGroups.description_en: The asset groups on which permissions are granted by using the authorization rule

HostAccountNames.description_en: The asset accounts on which permissions are granted by using the authorization rule

items.description_en: The username of the account that the policy authorizes users to manage in the asset group
items.description_zh: 资产组中已授权的账户名

HostGroupId.description_en: The ID of the asset group that the policy authorizes users to manage

Hosts.description_en: The information about the hosts that the policy authorizes users to manage

HostAccounts.description_en: The host accounts that the policy authorizes users to manage
HostAccounts.description_zh: 已授权的主机账户列表

HostAccountId.description_en: The ID of the host account that the policy authorizes users to manage

HostId.description_en: The ID of the host that the policy authorizes users to manage

RuleId.description_en: The ID of the authorization rule

RuleName.description_en: The name of the authorization rule

UserGroupId.description_en: The ID of the authorized user group

UserId.description_en: The ID of the authorized user
